_readme: Capture-source adapters for .cursor/rules/Meetings/meeting-sync.mdc. This file is the ONLY place a meeting-capture vendor is named. routing.json is deliberately vendor-free: it decides where a meeting goes, never where it came from. Swapping capture tools should mean editing this file and nothing else.
_confidence: Anything named in a source's `unconfirmed` array is a guess, not a verified fact. Do not present it to a human as established, and do not silently proceed when a call using it fails — say which unconfirmed value you were relying on. See 99_System/context/README.md for the marker convention and 99_System/context/99-open-questions.md for the open items.

normalised_meeting._readme: The shape every adapter must produce. The routing rules, the file template and the tracking file are all written against this and nothing else.

fields.id: Stable unique identifier, used as the dedupe key in backup_tracking.json. Must be stable across syncs.
fields.title: Meeting title, used by the routing priority table and the filename.
fields.start: Start datetime, local. Formats the YYYY-MM-DD_HHMM filename prefix and the Date line.
fields.participants: List of attendee names, used by the routing priority table.
fields.summary: Generated notes or summary. Rendered under '## Meeting Notes'.
fields.transcript: Full verbatim transcript. Rendered under '## Full Transcript'. May be empty.
fields.link: Optional permalink back to the source. Rendered at the bottom.

glean._readme: Glean meeting notes is the capture path as of 2026-09-13. The live sync uses Glean's remote MCP server. The previous sync was the local glean-scribe-extract.py cache script referenced by the old EOD agent; that script is no longer present. Glean transcribes locally from the desktop app across Meet, Teams, Zoom, Slack huddles and in-person, stores transcript plus metadata (never raw audio), and indexes the result as a first-class artefact. Docs: https://docs.glean.com/user-guide/assistant/meeting-notes/

mcp_server._note: Verified 2026-09-13. Cursor: glean_default in ~/.cursor/mcp.json. Claude Code: glean_default in user config ~/.claude.json, added against the same deployment URL. Claude Code still requires its one-time OAuth authentication before the headless digest can retrieve meetings.

tools._note: These three are documented built-ins of Glean's default MCP server, alongside employee_search, user_activity, memory and memory_schema. Source: https://docs.glean.com/administration/platform/mcp/create-mcp-servers . What is NOT documented anywhere is a meeting-specific tool. There is no Glean equivalent of list_meetings or get_meeting_transcript. Meeting notes are reached the same way any other artefact is: search to find them, read_document to open one.

list_filters._note: Use `after`/`before` for the requested sync window. The app=scribe filter is what isolates Glean Meeting Notes; observed results report Source: scribe and read_document reports datasource/docType: scribe.

retrieval._note: Verified 2026-09-13 with query=* plus app=scribe and owner=me. read_document returns the full transcript in richDocumentData.content.pageBody; richDocumentData.content is a JSON string and must be parsed. The observed summary field was null, so the adapter must not invent a generated summary.

field_map.title: search.title
field_map._note: Observed MCP payload, 2026-09-13. Use the canonical https://app.glean.com/library/transcript/<uuid> URL as the dedupe key; repeated searches returned the same URL, and read_document uses it as the resource identifier. Search exposes Created/Updated timestamps but no participants. Parse richDocumentData.content from JSON before reading summary/pageBody. The tested document had summary=null and a full pageBody transcript.

_fill_in: No adapter values remain unconfirmed. Operational prerequisite: complete one-time OAuth authentication for glean_default in Claude Code before relying on the nightly digest.

granola._readme: Granola was the capture source until 2026-09-13. Retained as a working adapter, not deleted: setting active_source to 'granola' is all it takes to switch back. Values here were in production use and are verified. The Granola-specific scripts and cached payloads are in 90_Archives/System/granola-sync/.

mcp_server._note: One locally-installed server, two identities, two independently-failing auth states. The mapping table in 99_System/distribution/harness-interop.md is the reference when one side breaks.

retrieval._note: get_meetings takes up to 10 ids per call. get_meeting_transcript is one call per meeting.
